_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'
move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, distance, axis, radius}
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.

says.meet: What a blazing match! You've got real fire in you. Only Giovanni remains now - the leader of them all. Give it everything you've got! Good luck!
says.repeat: Giovanni is the final wall. Burn bright, challenger!

says.meet: Cool your jets! Defeat Sabrina first, then we'll see if you can handle my flames!
says.repeat: No Sabrina, no fire. Come back when you've put out her mind games!

says.meet: Hah, that was a rock hard battle! You've got real grit, kid. The next leader is waiting for you - go and show Misty what you're made of!
says.repeat: Keep that defence as solid as a rock for the leaders ahead of you.

says.meet: What a wonderful battle. We should share tea sometime. Koga awaits you next - do be careful of his poisons. May the rest of your challenge bloom beautifully.
says.repeat: Take a moment to breathe before facing Koga. Good luck.

Gym Challenge Erika Locked.requires: not beaten: Gym Challenge Lt. Surge

says.meet: Oh... I'm afraid you must defeat Lt. Surge before challenging me. Patience, like a flower, takes time to bloom.
says.repeat: Please best Lt. Surge first, then return to me when you are ready.

says.meet: You have conquered the entire Gym Challenge. I underestimated you... Savour this victory, champion. You have earned my respect, and that is no small thing.
says.repeat: The challenge is complete. You stand above us all now.

says.meet: You are not yet worthy to face me. Defeat Blaine, then perhaps I shall grace you with a match.
says.repeat: Best Blaine first. Only then will I rise from this seat to meet you.

says.meet: Fwahaha... you have bested my arts. Sabrina senses your approach already... her mind games are not to be taken lightly. Good fortune, challenger.
says.repeat: Tread carefully from here - Sabrina sees all that is to come.

says.meet: A true ninja knows their order, challenger. Defeat Erika first, then seek me out from the shadows.
says.repeat: Erika stands between us. Best her, then return to face my poisons.

says.meet: Not bad, soldier! You've got the voltage after all. Erika's next - watch she doesn't put you to sleep! Good luck out there.
says.repeat: Onward and upward, recruit! Don't short out now.

says.meet: Whoa there, recruit! Defeat Misty before you come buzzing around me. No shortcuts in my unit!
says.repeat: No Misty, no match. Go on, move it move it!

says.meet: That was a really enjoyable match, we should play again sometime! Good luck with the rest of the challenge - Lt. Surge is up next, don't let him shock you!
says.repeat: Stay afloat out there! The leaders only get tougher from here.

says.meet: You can't challenge me without defeating Brock first! Beat him, then come back and we can play.
says.repeat: Go and beat Brock over there, then it'll be my turn to make a splash with you!

says.meet: Our minds have touched, and yours prevailed. Blaine burns bright ahead - do not let his flames consume you. Good luck.
says.repeat: Blaine's fire awaits you. I have already seen it.

says.meet: I see you have not yet defeated Koga. Return when his poison no longer clouds your path.
says.repeat: Koga first. The future cannot be rushed, challenger.

says.meet: Hah! I'm Blaine of Cinnabar Gym! So you scattered Sabrina's mind games? Then let's heat things up! My Fire deck burns hotter than the Cinnabar volcano. Can you take the heat? And no banned trainer cards!
says.repeat: Ready to get burned again?
says.first_win: Awesome! I've burned out... You've earned this coin. Giovanni is all that stands in your way now.
says.loss: Hah! You got burned to a crisp! Not even ashes remain!

Gym Challenge Blaine.music: Gym Leader Challenge Battle (Pokemon Card GB2 - Duel Vs Fortress Leader)

says.meet: I'm Brock, leader of Pewter Gym, and the Gym Challenge starts here with me. I lead with a rock hard defence. Are you ready to face my rock hard defence deck? Remember, the banned trainer cards aren't allowed in here.
says.repeat: Show me that rock hard resolve again!
says.first_win: Heh, you cracked right through my defence! You've earned the right to move on. Take this coin.
says.rematch_win: Still as solid as ever, but you're the stronger one.
says.loss: The best offense is a good defense! That's my way of doing things. Come back when your rocks are harder!

Gym Challenge Brock.music: Gym Leader Challenge Battle (Pokemon Card GB2 - Duel Vs Fortress Leader)

says.meet: Oh... hello. I am Erika of Celadon Gym. You made it past Lt. Surge? How lovely. My Grass Pokemon are delicate, but their bloom can be overwhelming. Shall we begin? Do mind the banned trainer cards.
says.repeat: Another match? How refreshing.
says.first_win: That was a delightful match. I felt inspired. Please, take this coin.
says.loss: Oh... is that all? My garden remains in full bloom.

Gym Challenge Erika.music: Gym Leader Challenge Battle (Pokemon Card GB2 - Duel Vs Fortress Leader)

says.meet: So. You've defeated every leader to reach me. I am Giovanni of Viridian Gym, the final and greatest of the Gym Leaders. I will show you the true meaning of power. This is where your challenge ends! And yes, the banned trainer cards stay out of this.
says.repeat: You wish to challenge me once more?
says.first_win: ...Impossible. You have bested every leader, even me. You are a true champion of the Gym Challenge. Take this coin - you have earned it, and more.
says.rematch_win: You continue to surpass my expectations.
says.loss: Ha! This is the extent of your power? You are not yet ready to defeat me.

Gym Challenge Giovanni.music: Gym Leader Challenge Battle (Pokemon Card GB2 - Duel Vs Fortress Leader)

says.meet: Fwahahaha! I am Koga of Fuchsia Gym, master of poison and the ninja arts. Erika's petals have wilted before you? Impressive. But my toxins seep where you cannot see. Prepare yourself! No banned trainer cards permitted.
says.repeat: Do you dare face my poisons again?
says.first_win: Heh... you saw through my smoke. A worthy challenger. This coin is yours.
says.rematch_win: Your eyes grow sharper each time we meet.
says.loss: Fwahaha! My poison courses through your veins. You were no match!

Gym Challenge Koga.music: Gym Leader Challenge Battle (Pokemon Card GB2 - Duel Vs Fortress Leader)

says.meet: I'm Lt. Surge! You beat the little lady, huh? Don't get cocky, kid. My Electric deck'll fry you where you stand! And don't even think about those banned trainer cards.
says.repeat: Back for another jolt, soldier?
says.first_win: Ha! You shorted out my whole army. Take the coin and move out!
says.rematch_win: You've got more voltage than I figured, kid.

Gym Challenge Lt. Surge.music: Gym Leader Challenge Battle (Pokemon Card GB2 - Duel Vs Fortress Leader)

says.meet: I'm Misty of Cerulean Gym! So you got past Brock? Good. My Water deck flows like a tidal wave - let's see if you can stay afloat! No banned trainer cards, remember the rules.
says.repeat: Ready to dive in again?
says.first_win: You really are strong and skilled! Take my coin and go show Lt. Surge what you've got.
says.rematch_win: Glad to see you're really making a splash!
says.loss: Yaaaay! My Water Pokemon washed you right out!

Gym Challenge Misty.music: Gym Leader Challenge Battle (Pokemon Card GB2 - Duel Vs Fortress Leader)

says.meet: I am Sabrina of Saffron Gym. I foresaw your arrival the moment Koga fell. My Psychic power bends the battle to my will. Let us see if your mind can withstand mine. The banned trainer cards have no place here.
says.repeat: I already know how this ends... but play on.
says.first_win: ...You shattered my vision. Astonishing. Take this coin; it was always meant for you.
says.loss: Just as I foresaw. Your mind was no match for mine.

Gym Challenge Sabrina.music: Gym Leader Challenge Battle (Pokemon Card GB2 - Duel Vs Fortress Leader)
